fusions.name: Spilled Seed
fusions.desc: Spits a seed that deals 8 damage and roots the target, leaving it [Slowed] for 5 seconds. It holds 4 charges, and a kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Pod Burst
fusions.desc: Bursts seed pods in a ring, dealing 9 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocking them back 2 tiles. Its damage rises 10% for each affliction on the target, up to 30%.

fusions.name: Henhouse Garden
fusions.desc: Raises a growth where you stand. For 10 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally inside it. Every ally within 5.5 tiles makes it 11% stronger, up to 4 allies.

fusions.name: Deep Roots
fusions.desc: When you gain health, you regain 2 health a second for 5 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.
